rightsNote: The backgrounds are distinct public-domain images from an Arabic treatise on ʿilm al-raml. The figures are the sixteen canonical one-or-two-point forms, rendered as solid mineral-ink points in manuscript-style ruled panels; the fixed card format is a transparent modern interface adaptation of a generated geomantic practice.

cards.sourceTitle: Treatise on ʿilm al-raml, MS Arabic 664, image 25
cards.treatment: A canonical four-line geomantic figure is rendered as solid mineral-ink points inside a manuscript-style ruled panel over one distinct public-domain manuscript image. This is a modern card treatment, not an original historical deck.
